title: Red Allen on Dizzy Gillespie
summary: Red Allen thought he could play better than anyone.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Getting back to Dizzy Gillespie and the musicians who were playing the other kind of music, about 1945, how about the other trumpet players? What did Red Allen think of Dizzy's playing?
Red Allen, if you want to know the truth, he didn't think about nobody's (side of it at all.)
I know. I mean, how did he like the way Dizzy played?
That's what I'm talking about, not to copy Dizzy, no.
He always felt like he could play better than anybody else. I'm telling you what I know.
